q: Mean equicontinuity (m.e.c.) is a weakening of equicontinuity using Cesàro averages. A minimal system is mean equicontinuous if and only if it is:
opts: Weakly almost periodic (the family {T^n} is relatively weakly compact in C(X))
Uniquely ergodic and has discrete spectrum
exp: Mean equicontinuity (Li-Tu-Ye): a minimal system is m.e.c. iff it is uniquely ergodic with discrete (pure point) spectrum — all eigenvalues of the Koopman operator. This connects topological mean equicontinuity to the measure-theoretic pure point spectrum condition.
